name: Rooftop Rally
hint: Crates, throws, creaky boards and springs: the whole roof at once.
why4: The trapdoor into the tunnel holds 3 and only breaks under all four; at the end two must be thrown up two roofs to hold the 2-plate that unlids the springs for the two left below.
solution: Stage 1: P1 stands at x=6 (edge of the gap at x=4-5), grabs P2, faces left and throws P2 onto the balcony (x=1-3, height 3); P2 walks to the wall. P1 throws P3 the same way; P3 hops onto P2's head. P1 grabs the crate at x=12 and throws it from x=6 onto the balcony: plate 3/3, bridge E over the 7-wide pit (x=15-21) appears.
P1 and P4 walk over the bridge; P4 touches the toggle button at x=24: bridge E stays up for good. Everyone else jumps clear over the button (touching it again would toggle the bridge off).
P3 and P2 jump right off the balcony (over the crate and the gap at x=4-5) and walk over the bridge.
Stage 2: one at a time, everyone crosses the 1-bridge at x=30-35 (two on it, or one carrying a friend, and it crumbles; it is back after 3 s).
All four stand on the trapdoor at x=40-45: at weight 4 it breaks and everyone drops into the trench. Walk right through the tunnel and touch the flag at x=58 (new respawn point).

Stage 3: P4 stands at x=65 (edge of the gap at x=66-67), grabs P1 and throws right onto roof 1 (height 3, face x=68). P1 walks to x=73, picking up the key at x=70 on the way. P4 throws P3 the same way; P1 sets the key down in front of P3 (P3 picks it up).
On roof 1, P1 stands at x=73 (edge of the gap at x=74-75), throws P3, then P2 (thrown up by P4 too), onto roof 2 (3 higher, face x=76).
P3 and P2 stand on the plate at x=80-81 (2/2): both lids A open.
P4 steps into the hole at x=64 onto the spring and steers right onto roof 1, then into the hole at x=72 and steers onto roof 2. P1 steps into the hole at x=72 and steers onto roof 2.
P3 opens the door at x=88; all four press Down.
Recovery: anyone falling in a stage-3 gap respawns at the flag; while two hold the plate they come back up by the springs. A crate that falls returns to x=12.
